page: Amazon Web Services m9gd.8xlarge is a general-purpose server powered by custom AWS Graviton ARMv9 processors. It features 32 dedicated physical cores running at 3.3 GHz on the Neoverse-V3 architecture, with 1.0 thread per core. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is provided via a bundled 1900 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, and the server operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 17 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals strong multi-core capabilities and memory performance. The server achieved top-tier status in single-threaded gzip compression, single-threaded bzip3 decompression, and static web serving throughput. Passmark memory and database operations tests also placed in the top tier. Multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Redis SET operations scored in the strong tier, while single-core CPU performance and large-block memory bandwidth fell into the average tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 architecture and dedicated physical cores deliver high resource density and strong performance-per-watt characteristics. The integration of a fast local NVMe SSD eliminates the need for external block storage for high-IOPS workloads, optimizing overall infrastructure spend. This hardware profile is suited for database hosting, caching layers, web serving, and multi-threaded data processing tasks.
